name: Venus: Improbable Dream
source:
Akane Kakeru is not your average 17 year old. Thanks to a disfigurement he gained at birth, he spends his days struggling with social anxiety and wishing to be invisible. 

Everything changes for him when he's placed into the after school music club, in an attempt to coax him out of his shell. It's here that he meets Haruka Fujiwara, a disabled girl with a shy disposition, and a gift for music. As the two of them begin to connect, Kakeru remembers what it's like to yearn for friends, to be confident in himself, and most importantly, to have a dream. 

Will Kakeru be able to truly face his inner fears once and for all, and achieve something he never thought possible? That’s up to you!

[From [url=https://borealisgames.itch.io/venus-improbable-dream-free-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Akane Kakeru并不是普通的17岁少年。出生时留下的容貌缺陷，让他每天都在与社交焦虑挣扎，恨不得自己能隐形。

为了鼓励他敞开心扉，他被安排加入课后音乐社，人生也因此改变。在那里，他遇见了性情害羞、身有残疾，却拥有音乐天赋的女孩Haruka Fujiwara。随着两人逐渐亲近，Kakeru重新想起渴望朋友、相信自己，以及最重要的，拥有梦想，究竟是什么感觉。

他能否彻底直面内心的恐惧，实现从未想过可能做到的事？这就取决于你了！
